# Madhuban Eco Retreat


> Madhuban Eco Retreat is an eco-luxury forest resort located near Ratapani Wildlife Sanctuary, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The retreat focuses on sustainable hospitality, nature-based experiences, forest stays, and mindful travel rooted in local ecology and community values.


## About Madhuban Eco Retreat
- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/about-us  
  Overview of Madhuban Eco Retreat, its philosophy, sustainability vision, and approach to responsible tourism in Madhya Pradesh.


## Booking
- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/booking  
  Check availability and book a stay directly — safari tents, mud houses, glamping tents, pool villas, and camping.


## Stay & Accommodation
- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve  
  Overview of eco-friendly accommodation options including Safari Tents, Mud Houses, Glamping Tents, Poolside Villas, and Camping Tents.


- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve/safari-tent  
  Safari-style tent accommodation offering eco-luxury forest stays near Ratapani Wildlife Sanctuary.


- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve/mud-house-standard  
  Mud Houses inspired by Gond tribal architecture, offering sustainable and nature-integrated living.


- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve/pool-side-villa  
  Poolside villas designed for relaxation, wellness, and forest-side comfort.


- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve/glamping-tents  
  Boutique glamping tents combining comfort with immersive outdoor living.


- https://www.madhubanecoretreat.com/stay-in-ratapani-tiger-reserve/camping-tent  
  Camping experience for guests seeking simple, off-grid forest stays.

## Property Details
- Distance from Bhopal: 60 km via NH-46
- Check-in: 2:00 PM | Check-out: 11:00 AM
- Phone: +91 97705 58419
- Email: madhubanresort@somaiya.com
- Address: Village Bori, Salkanpur Road, Rehti, Sehore, Madhya Pradesh 466446
- Room types, per night for 2 guests on the MAP plan (breakfast, lunch/dinner), regular season, before GST: Safari Tent (₹13,200), Pool Side Villa (₹13,200), Mud House Premium (₹11,200), Mud House Standard (₹10,200), Glamping Tent (₹8,700)
- AP plan (breakfast, lunch and dinner) adds ₹1,000 per night: Safari Tent and Pool Side Villa ₹14,200, Mud House Premium ₹12,200, Mud House Standard ₹11,200, Glamping Tent ₹9,700
- Every fare is the room rate plus the meal plan (MAP adds ₹1,200, AP adds ₹2,200 per night to the room rate)
- Peak season and long weekends (21 December to 4 January, Christmas/New Year, Dussehra 17-20 Oct 2026, Diwali 6-14 Nov 2026, Holi 19-22 Mar 2027): +20% on the room rate, meal plan unchanged (for example Mud House Standard MAP ₹12,000)
- Stay 2 nights or more: flat 20% off the room rate, not available in peak season or long weekends; the meal plan is not discounted (for example Mud House Standard MAP ₹8,400 per night)
- Additional guests per night: adult ₹2,600 (MAP) or ₹3,200 (AP); child 5-12 years ₹1,800 (MAP) or ₹2,100 (AP); one child under 5 years is free
- Tariff 2026-27, valid 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027
- Activities: Wildlife safari, nature walks, birdwatching, yoga, pottery, bush dining
- GST (extra): 18% where the value of the night is above ₹7,500 | 5% where it is ₹7,500 or below
